photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg: no stock on page; one consistent drawn sheet system (graph paper, numbered callouts, SHEET 0n title blocks naming house type + neighborhood); checklist sheet doubles as tool output; honest illustration disclaimer in footer. Highlands sheet (1440-scroll-50.jpg) is the thin one.

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg / dist/index.html: trade-native, place-specific lines (shutoff valve, cottages swell in July), honest limits box, checklist empty state; all claims in facts.json, Sample labels on prices and reviews (1440-full.jpg). Per-stop CTAs each use a new verb vs 'Price a visit'.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: lead form 'Next' is an unstyled default button ~32px tall, below 48px (mustFix). 390-first.jpg: hero not re-cut, drawing below fold; mobile bar primary red vs brass hero. Footer phone line wraps with hanging middle dot. No sideways scroll (render.json).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: every word, sign and sheet visible; one h1, no heading skips, 3px brass focus-visible, forced-colors and skip link in dist/index.html. Default 'Next' control outside the designed focus system (390-full.jpg).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg: route draws down the stop rail, signs flip up (hidden pre-trigger in 1440-full.jpg, present in 1440-rm-full.jpg), hero sheet swing, checklist marks drawing (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Route is a thin gutter rule; no single retellable motion idea.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: Derby checklist tied to trade, city and season; ticks mark the porch drawing. Text result is a plain dark box with one line; nothing keepable or printable shown.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: unstyled browser-default 'Next' button in the lead form (-0.5); 1440-scroll-50.jpg: inspection card rules slice through text baselines; radius mix (pill chips, 4px buttons, rounded review cards).

mustFix.problem: 'Next' renders as an unstyled browser-default button about 32px tall: below the 48px tap target and the only control that advances the lead form
mustFix.fix: Give the form step buttons the primary button style (brass fill, ink text, min-height 48px, padding 0 18px, 4px radius, the 3px brass focus ring), full width under 640px

elevate.move: Compose the 390 first screen around a cropped detail of the hero sheet (porch with callouts 1-3) set beside the street sign, and give each stop a phone order of sign, sheet crop, fixes, so the phone reads as its own walk instead of the desktop collapsed

Turn the lead form into the final survey sheet (SHEET 06, YOUR LIST) in the same graph-paper frame, title block and red callout numbering, so the form, ZIP check and footer close the walk in the drawn system rather than in generic form chrome
